comment: Britain, Trammel. Landmarks come from Spawns/trammel.xml vendor spawn points, Data/Regions.xml town bounds and the ModernUO shard's britain-daily-life.json. Every road waypoint and every edge in this file was then verified against real map data with [NavAudit, and the ones that were wrong were replaced with coordinates flood-filled from the map itself - which is why the descent from the upper town runs east through 1472,1639 rather than down the middle of the block. Z is advisory: the pathing goal uses map.GetAverageZ when the authored Z will not fit. Session 7e adds the work layer: two faces of the mountain west of town, the wood to the north-west, and the forge in the north smithy. NONE OF IT WAS AUTHORED BY HAND. Every wilderness waypoint, arrival point and zone rect below came out of [BotWorkScout, which asks the engine the same questions the runtime asks - HarvestDefinition.Validate for what can be dug, map.CanFit at NavWalker.ResolveZ for what can be stood on, and MovementPath both ways for every hop, which is verbatim what [NavAudit tests. An earlier pass derived the same data offline from the client's MUL and UOP files and was wrong: it read a flat z -5 along a corridor the engine resolves at 30, 50 and -15, and [NavAudit rejected fourteen of its edges. The corridors run AROUND the mountain rather than at it, which is why the route to the north face leaves by the north of town and the route to the south face leaves by the south. The forge and anvil coordinates come from Data/Decoration/Britannia/britain.cfg.
